_about: Frozen at b5d9258 (cathedral.json era) by rendering each look as the bake does (t = f / 40, default gamma and brightness) and hashing its full DMX frames. test/rig-folly.test.js renders them again on rig.json. Re-made when a r moved to the LEDs' mean (the effects audit's core fix), when add and blur moved to light, and when colour fades moved to OKLab. The composed look's re-made when the look's speed and grade went (it had speed 1.3, level, hue and saturation).
